ops.DECALL: lazy::decode() of every node through lazy elements/entries, strings summed
ops.PATH1: at_path one node (twitter $.statuses[50].id, floats $[1000], records $[1000].id; cwt not measured: the path does not enter tag 18)
ops.LAZY: lazy elements/entries over every node, no decode

each_iteration: a new top-level item from a shared_ptr to the document (no copy); one document, warm cache
